title: Plant MitoCarta & Inter-Organellar Bioenergetic Atlas: Subcellular Digital Doubles, Retrograde Signaling Circuits, and Multi-Omics Spaceflight Projections
description:
Plant MitoCarta is a computable, identifier-bound cross-compartment ontology, digital double suite, and multi-omics projection toolkit for plant mitochondria, chloroplasts, the nucleus, and the plasma membrane in Arabidopsis thaliana.

It provides an open, reproducible framework for investigating organellar retrograde signaling, plant-specific bioenergetic innovations, and cross-species synteny with the mammalian Broad MitoCarta 3.0, with direct projection of microgravity multi-omics from the NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR).

Key Components & Capabilities:

  • Four Subcellular Digital Doubles: Mitochondria (Complexes I–V, plant-specific bypasses AOX1a-d, type II NDA/NDB/NDC dehydrogenases, Complex I CA domain, UCP1, TCA cycle, and GDC photorespiratory complex), Chloroplast (PSI, PSII, Cyt b6f, RuBisCO, retrograde branches SAL1-PAP, GUN1-ABI4, MEcPP, EXECUTER 1/2), Nucleus (MDRE promoters, ANAC017/013, ABI4, GLK1/2, XRN2/3), and Plasma Membrane (mechanosensitive/gravity channels MSL10, MCA, PIEZO; wall receptor kinases FERONIA, WAK1; NADPH oxidases RBOHD/F; GLR3.3/3.6 Ca2+ channels; PIP2;1 aquaporins).
  • Five Operational Signaling Circuits: Mito-to-Nucleus MRR (ANAC017/013 proteolytic cascade), Plasto-to-Nucleus PRR (SAL1-PAP & GUN1 retrograde axis), Plasma Membrane Perception & Systemic Waves (GLR Ca2+ spikes and RBOHD apoplastic ROS bursts), Three-Organelle Photorespiratory Conduit (chloroplast–peroxisome–mitochondria flux), and Physical Inter-Organellar Contact Sites (MEAMs and nuclear-docked stromules).
  • Broad MitoCarta 3.0 Cross-Kingdom Synthesis: Systematic synteny alignment across 149 human MitoPathways organized into 4 evolutionary quadrants (Conserved Catalytic Core, Plant-Specific Innovations, Dual-Targeted Divergence, and Expanded Plant Families).
  • SUBA5 Subcellular Proteomics Consensus: Rigorous integration of SUBAcon consensus scores, mass spectrometry evidence, confocal GFP imaging, and dual-targeting classification.
  • NASA OSDR Spaceflight Ingestion: Direct ingestion and projection of microgravity transcriptomics and proteomics from OSD-120 (ISS APEX-03-2 root vs. shoot), OSD-427, OSD-37, OSD-782, and OSD-8 without synthetic fallback.
  • Standardized Interoperable Data Formats: Systems Biology Graphical Notation (SBGN-ML), vector SVG maps, GSEA-compatible GMT gene sets (21 sets), Cytoscape network graph (CYJS), and comprehensive multi-omics locus tables (TSV).
